results.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Customer
SELECT count(*) FROM Track T JOIN Genre G ON T.GenreId = G.GenreId WHERE G.Name = 'Rock'
SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice

-- ASSUMPTION: top 5 billing countries = countries with the highest sum of Total invoice amounts
SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS TotalRevenue
FROM Invoice
GROUP BY BillingCountry
ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC
LIMIT 5

-- ASSUMPTION: most albums = highest count of unique AlbumId associated with an artist
SELECT T2.Name, COUNT(T1.AlbumId) AS AlbumCount FROM Album AS T1 JOIN Artist AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId GROUP BY T2.ArtistId, T2.Name ORDER BY AlbumCount DESC LIMIT 3

-- ASSUMPTION: top 5 genres by sales revenue = highest sum of (UnitPrice * Quantity) per genre
SELECT g.Name, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS TotalRevenue
FROM Genre g
JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name
ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC
LIMIT 5
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM InvoiceDate) AS InvoiceYear, COUNT(InvoiceId) AS InvoiceCount FROM Invoice GROUP BY InvoiceYear ORDER BY InvoiceYear
SELECT BillingCountry, AVG(Total) FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry HAVING COUNT(InvoiceId) >= 5

-- ASSUMPTION: top-spending = highest total sum of invoice totals per customer
WITH CustomerTotals AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Country, 
        c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS FullName, 
        ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS TotalSpent,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.Country ORDER BY ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) DESC) as rnk
    FROM Customer c
    JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
    GROUP BY c.Country, c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName
)
SELECT Country, FullName, TotalSpent
FROM CustomerTotals
WHERE rnk = 1
SELECT Name FROM Artist WHERE ArtistId NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT Album.ArtistId FROM InvoiceLine JOIN Track ON InvoiceLine.TrackId = Track.TrackId JOIN Album ON Track.AlbumId = Album.AlbumId)
SELECT count(*) FROM Invoice WHERE date_part('year', InvoiceDate) = 2012
SELECT ROUND(AVG(Milliseconds) / 60000, 2) FROM Track
SELECT Country, COUNT(CustomerId) FROM Customer GROUP BY Country
SELECT month(InvoiceDate) AS Month, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS Revenue FROM Invoice WHERE year(InvoiceDate) = 2012 GROUP BY month(InvoiceDate) ORDER BY Month
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN BillingCountry = 'USA' THEN Total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice
SELECT count(*) FROM Track WHERE TrackId NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT TrackId FROM InvoiceLine)

-- ASSUMPTION: spent = sum of Total from Invoice table
WITH CustomerSpend AS (
    SELECT 
        c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS FullName,
        SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpent
    FROM Customer c
    JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
    GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName
)
SELECT 
    FullName, 
    ROUND(TotalSpent, 2) AS TotalSpent
FROM CustomerSpend
WHERE TotalSpent > (SELECT AVG(TotalSpent) FROM CustomerSpend)
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT CustomerId FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId HAVING count(InvoiceId) > 6) AS sub

-- ASSUMPTION: longest average track length = highest average Milliseconds per genre
SELECT g.Name, ROUND(AVG(t.Milliseconds) / 60000, 2) AS AverageLengthMinutes
FROM Genre g
JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name
ORDER BY AverageLengthMinutes DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT FirstName || ' ' || LastName AS FullName, COUNT(DISTINCT T.GenreId) AS GenreCount FROM Customer C JOIN Invoice I ON C.CustomerId = I.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine IL ON I.InvoiceId = IL.InvoiceId JOIN Track T ON IL.TrackId = T.TrackId GROUP BY C.CustomerId, C.FirstName, C.LastName HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T.GenreId) > 5

-- ASSUMPTION: revenue change is the difference between the current month's total invoice sum and the previous month's total invoice sum.
WITH MonthlyRevenue AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM InvoiceDate) AS Month,
        SUM(Total) AS Revenue
    FROM Invoice
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM InvoiceDate) = 2011
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
    curr.Month,
    ROUND(curr.Revenue, 2) AS Revenue,
    ROUND(curr.Revenue - prev.Revenue, 2) AS RevenueChange
FROM MonthlyRevenue curr
JOIN MonthlyRevenue prev ON curr.Month = prev.Month + 1
ORDER BY curr.Month

SELECT T2.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT T1.GenreId) AS GenreCount FROM Track AS T1 JOIN Album AS T3 ON T1.AlbumId = T3.AlbumId JOIN Artist AS T2 ON T3.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId GROUP BY T2.ArtistId, T2.Name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T1.GenreId) >= 3

-- ASSUMPTION: percentage of total sales revenue = (sum of (unit price * quantity) for genre / sum of (unit price * quantity) for all genres) * 100
WITH GenreRevenue AS (
    SELECT 
        g.Name, 
        SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) as Revenue
    FROM Genre g
    JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
    JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
    GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name
),
TotalRevenue AS (
    SELECT SUM(Revenue) as Total FROM GenreRevenue
)
SELECT 
    gr.Name, 
    ROUND((gr.Revenue / tr.Total) * 100, 2) as Percentage
FROM GenreRevenue gr, TotalRevenue tr

SELECT FirstName || ' ' || LastName FROM Customer WHERE CustomerId NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT i.CustomerId FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Latin')

WITH LatestInvoices AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerId, 
        MAX(InvoiceDate) as MaxDate
    FROM Invoice
    GROUP BY CustomerId
)
SELECT 
    c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS FullName, 
    i.InvoiceDate, 
    i.Total
FROM Customer c
JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
JOIN LatestInvoices li ON i.CustomerId = li.CustomerId AND i.InvoiceDate = li.MaxDate
